desc:
First Jujutsu Kaisen Tower Defense game on Roblox!

⬆️ Update 31.0 
 
The Culling Game is here!

Fight various culling players and obtain them as units, open orbs and gain amazing loot!

New units:
- Projection Sorcerer [NEW SPECIAL GRADE]

- Claws Sorcerer [FREE BATTLE PASS]
- Explosive Sorcerer [PREMIUM BATTLE PASS]

- Justice Sorcerer
- Lightning Sorcerer 
- Kogane


📝 3 New Codes!

✅ Place down jujutsu sorcerers and defeat curses! Get the strongest sorcerer!
Game is inspired by jjk anime, however some manga units are included!

🅰️ VERSION ALPHA This is an early release of the game and may contain bugs, we are always working on fixing all issues as soon as they come up, please be patient if an issue occurs, 

➕ Premium Benefits: More Coins and Gems per minute for staying in the AFK zone!
